Calibrate confidence scores and build detection histories

Source: R/calibrate.R
calibrate.Rd

Runs the whole calibration stage: reads the reviewed clips, compares the candidate models by cross-validation, refits the best one to all the clips, optionally draws the effort curve, scores every detection of the complete selection tables and builds the nightly detection history. Writes to output_dir:

  • model_comparison.csv (compare_calibration_models());

  • calibration_folds.csv, when fold_group is supplied: validation row number, site, species, grouping columns and assigned fold;

  • calibration_model.rds and calibration_model.txt (the refitted best model and its summary);

  • calibration_curves.png (plot_calibration()), when 'ggplot2' is installed;

  • effort_curve.csv (calibration_effort()), when effort_curve is TRUE;

  • calibrated_detections_<site>.csv, one per site (score_detections());

  • nightly_detection_history.csv (detection_history());

  • detection_summary.csv (summarise_history()).

Usage

calibrate(
  validation_files,
  prediction_tables,
  output_dir,
  site_map = NULL,
  min_confidence = 0.1,
  p_min = 0.95,
  min_detections_night = 1,
  dawn_hour = 12,
  k_folds = 5,
  select = c("one_se_logloss", "best_auc"),
  uncorrelated = FALSE,
  effort_curve = FALSE,
  effort_n = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30),
  effort_reps = 50,
  engine = c("lme4", "brms"),
  prior = NULL,
  brms_args = list(),
  rule = c("mean", "probability"),
  prob_min = 0.9,
  seed = 2026,
  fold_group = NULL
)

Arguments

validation_files

Paths to the validation_by_clip.csv files of the sites (v1.2.0 validacao_por_clipe.csv files are also read).

prediction_tables

Named character vector of the complete selection tables, named by site.

output_dir

Output folder; created if needed. The calibrated detections of a large project can take hundreds of MB.

site_map

Optional named character vector to fix diverging site names, as c(old = "new"), e.g. c(BEP2 = "BEP").

min_confidence

Detections below this confidence are not scored.

p_min

Threshold on the calibrated probability (not on the confidence score).

min_detections_night

Repetition rule: minimum number of reliable detections for a night with detection.

dawn_hour

Recordings that start before this hour belong to the night before.

k_folds

Number of folds.

select

Rule to choose the model; see select_calibration_model().

uncorrelated

Include the m4 variant without the species intercept-slope correlation among the candidates; see calibration_models().

effort_curve

Draw the effort curve (slow).

effort_n, effort_reps

Training sizes and repetitions of the effort curve.

engine

Engine of the final fit: "lme4" or "brms" (see fit_calibration()). The comparison of the candidate models always uses maximum likelihood (fast); with "brms", the selected model is then refitted in a Bayesian framework, its convergence diagnostics are written to calibration_diagnostics.csv, and the scored detections carry p_tp_lower and pr_reliable.

prior

engine = "brms": the prior, as a brmsprior object or as a function of the selected formula and the validations that returns one, e.g. calibration_prior (whose classes then match the selected model). Required with "brms".

brms_args

engine = "brms": list of further arguments for brms::brm() (e.g. list(chains = 4, cores = 4, backend = "cmdstanr")).

rule

When a detection is reliable: "mean", its calibrated probability (the posterior mean with engine = "brms") is >= p_min; "probability", the posterior probability that P(TP) >= p_min (the pr_reliable of a model fitted with engine = "brms") is >= prob_min. The second rule propagates the uncertainty of the calibration and is more conservative where few clips were reviewed.

prob_min

rule = "probability": threshold on pr_reliable. pr_reliable is computed in score_detections() for its p_min; use the same p_min in both.

seed

Seed of the fold assignment. The global random number generator is left as it was.

fold_group

Optional character vector of grouping columns. Do not include species, verdicts or confidence scores: these would split recordings or nights by species or by outcome. Group IDs must be nonmissing and nonempty. NULL keeps the original clip folds.

Value

A list with comparison, fit, effort (or NULL), scored and history, invisibly.

Details

The candidate family follows the observed species and sites: one species uses the site-effect family of calibration_models(), and a single site omits non-estimable site random effects.

The model is chosen by select_calibration_model() with the rule select: by default, the simplest model within one standard error of the lowest log-loss, leaving out models singular in most folds ("one_se_logloss"). Use select = "best_auc" to reproduce the 2.x selection by highest mean AUC. When the refit is singular, fit_calibration() warns; read calibration_model.txt and the comparison before using the probabilities.

Converting BirdNET confidence scores into probabilities is recommended by the BirdNET authors (Wood & Kahl 2024, doi:10.1007/s10336-024-02144-5 ); calibration by logistic regression on logit(score) is applied, for instance, by Owens et al. (2026, doi:10.64898/2026.06.01.729442 ). This function extends that approach with a hierarchical multi-species structure. This is the function form of the v1.2.0 script calibracao.R.
